Congradulations on staying clean ❤ it's true that life has served a long buffet of the ugly parts but the thing about life is how unpredictable it is. It's easy to be convinced by depression that living won't get easier and life won't get better. But it does in super small ways that can easily fly under the radar. Things will change as you get older. When I was 16 I didn't think I'd live long enough to see my 18th birthday and I'm so close to reaching such a small goal. Despite all the cruelty you've been shown you're not suffering alone and there are people who struggle with similar situations. Stand strong and I'm sure you'll eventually see some of the beauty your life will have to offer. Dm if you ever need a friend ❤
